# Channel

`Channel` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `channel:name()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`name()`](name.md) | Get / Set the channel name. | 1.6.0 |
| [`direction()`](direction.md) | Get / Set the direction of the channel (1 is normal / -1 reverse) | 1.6.0 |
| [`min()`](min.md) | Get / Set the min percent of the channel. | 1.6.0 |
| [`max()`](max.md) | Get / Set the max percent of the channel. | 1.6.0 |
| [`center()`](center.md) | Get / Set the center percent of the channel. | 1.6.0 |
| [`pwmCenter()`](pwmCenter.md) | Get / Set the pwm center value of the channel. | 1.6.0 |
| [`slowUp()`](slowUp.md) | Get / Set the Slow-up value of the channel. | 1.6.4 |
| [`slowDown()`](slowDown.md) | Get / Set the Slow-down value of the channel. | 1.6.4 |
